instruction.text: How many children are on the left ← of the tree?
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>birds-short</voice> How many children are on the left of the tree?

instruction.text: How many children are on the right → of the tree?
instruction.sound: and how many children are on the right of the tree?

trainers.finishSound: there is only one child. Good job!

instruction.text: How many pens and pencils are in the right → pot?
instruction.sound: How many pens and pencils are in the right pot?

instruction.text: How many pens and pencils are in the left ← pot?
instruction.sound: and how many pens and pencils are in the left pot?

instruction.text: How many cupcakes are on the left ←?
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>dh-phoneme-m</voice> Yummy! How many cupcakes are on the left?

trainers.finishSound: Good! There are two cupcakes on the left.

instruction.text: How many cupcakes are on the right →?
instruction.sound: How many cupcakes are on the right?

trainers.finishSound: There is only one cupcake on the right. Keep it up!

instruction.text: How many scoops of ice cream are on the right →?
instruction.sound: How many scoops of ice cream are on the right?

trainers.finishSound: Correct, there are three scoops of ice cream.

instruction.text: How many scoops of ice cream are on the left ←?
instruction.sound: How many scoops of ice cream are on the left?

trainers.finishSound: there is one scoop on the left. Well spotted!
